$description: DarkSwap design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit values here only -- do not hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx. The dev server regenerates them on every change (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, wired through vite.config.ts). Colors are authored as hex; the generator converts them to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile (tokens.tsx). Every color role exists in both light and dark. Dark is the brand-true, default theme, sampled from the DarkSwap logo mark, wordmark lockup, launch banner and tokenomics art; light is derived from the same violet ramp. No lime or yellow-green value is a role in this system.

background.$description: Derived light companion. The brand art supplies no light surface, so this is a neutral page with violet-tinted supporting roles.

primary.$description: Primary brand color. A darker step of the logo gradient's violet so white label text clears WCAG AA on a light page.

secondary.$description: Lavender-tinted secondary surface: secondary buttons, quiet panels, inactive tabs.

accent.$description: Interactive violet tint for hover, focus and selected rows.

background.$description: Near-black page, sampled from the 2026 campaign art (monolith, dark pool and wallet renders).

card.$description: Raised surface: cards, widget shells, route cards.

primary.$description: Primary brand color, sampled from the campaign art's bright violet. Drives primary actions and links.

secondary.$description: Violet-tinted panel, sampled from the banner and tokenomics cards. Secondary buttons, inset rows, inactive tabs.

mutedForeground.$description: Lifted from the art's dim label grey so body-size muted text clears WCAG AA on both the page and card surfaces.

accent.$description: Brighter violet-tinted interactive surface for hover, focus and selected rows.

destructive.$description: Failure red, lifted for near-black. A deeper red reads as red on a filled button but drops below WCAG AA as standalone error text on a card; this step clears AA both ways and takes a near-black label on the filled variant.

ring.$description: Bright lavender focus ring; the upper stop of the logo gradient, chosen so focus is unmistakable on near-black.

sans.$description: UI, body and display face. SUBSTITUTION: the launch banner's headline is a heavy grotesque that was never supplied as a font file, so Inter (up to 900) stands in for it. Set headings in 700-900 to carry the banner's weight.

serif.$description: The brand art uses no serif. Filled deliberately for long-form editorial copy only; product surfaces stay on sans.

mono.$description: Numerals, amounts, rates and addresses. Chosen for tabular figures and unambiguous 0/O and 1/l.

base.$description: Base corner radius; sm/md/lg/xl derive from this. Matches the softly rounded cards and widget shells in the brand art.
